newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Zurich airport 1996 cargo traffic up 1.4 per cent.
newsitem.headline: Zurich airport 1996 cargo traffic up 1.4 per cent.

text.p: Global cargo traffic handled at Zurich Airport in 1996 was up 1.4 percent on the previous year at 445,640 tonnes, airport authority figures show.
Cargo traffic handled by Swiss airlines at Zurich Airport last year declined by 2.2 percent on 1995 levels to 243,674 tonnes while foreign carriers volume was up by 1.4 percent to 78,867 tonnes.
Last year, trucked airfreight handled at Zurich Airport grew by 9.6 percent on 1995, to 123,099 tonnes, the airport authority said.
Postal traffic handled at the airport last year totalled 17,550 tonnes, up 2.5 percent on 1995. -- Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+ 5017
